Name: Custom NPC Snow English Translation
Author: Renkrovo
Description:
Translation of the original mod description:

NPC Backstory

Snow from the Coral Clan

Because Snow's Clan was decieved by humans and hunted by them. In order to eliminate the humans, Snow used forbidden magic out of her selfishness which resulted in her losing half of her soul and unexpectedly falling into a deep slumber.

Hundreds of years later, due to the arrival of the farmer, Snow woke up from her deep sleep and realized that the farmer is a fragment of her soul.

Installation:
Install the original mod and then paste the contents of the zip file into it.
